title: Mexican-Inspired Black Bean Bowl
style: Smoky, bright, deeply seasoned bean bowl with real texture and contrast
description: A bold, satisfying black bean bowl with properly bloomed spices, smoky depth, bright lime, and contrasting textures.

items.item: extra charred corn or tortilla strips

steps: Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add red onion and bell pepper with a pinch of salt and cook until soft and lightly caramelised.
Add garlic, cumin, chilli powder or smoked paprika, tomato paste, and cocoa powder. Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture darkens to a brick-red colour and smells deeply fragrant.
Stir in chipotle paste (or liquid smoke), then add black beans and salt. Cook a few minutes until beans are hot and well coated.
Remove from heat and finish with lime zest and juice.
Build bowls with rice or quinoa, black beans, corn, cherry tomatoes, and avocado. Finish with fresh cilantro and any optional toppings.
tips: Blooming spices with tomato paste transforms canned beans into something slow-cooked.
Cocoa adds depth, not chocolate — you shouldn’t taste it.
Lime zest at the end is non-negotiable for balance.
